messages.text:
"Create a massive open-world monster-catching RPG inspired by creature collection games, but with a unique identity and original designs.

Monster Capture System: Players capture wild monsters using futuristic Capture Discs instead of Poké Balls. Each Disc has unique abilities, capture rates, and upgrade levels.

Monster Collection: Create at least 1,000 unique monsters, each with different appearances, elements, abilities, evolutions, personalities, stats, and special attacks.

Arena System: Build at least 20 massive Arenas, each controlled by a powerful Arena Leader with unique monsters, battle strategies, challenges, and rewards. Players must defeat all Arena Leaders to unlock the ultimate championship.

Gameplay: Explore a huge seamless open world, discover rare monsters, fight wild creatures, train and evolve your team, complete quests, challenge other trainers, and participate in tournaments.

Include legendary monsters, secret bosses, rare variants, breeding, trading, crafting, monster evolution, and an epic main storyline.

Create a complete playable RPG with real mechanics, intelligent monster AI, strategic turn-based battles, exploration, progression, and a living world. Everything must be functional, not just visual placeholders.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
